name: Shandong Yisheng Livestock & Poultry Breeding Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Yisheng Livestock & Poultry Breeding Co., Ltd. engages in the livestock and poultry business in China and internationally. The company is involved in the import and raising of grandparent broiler breeders; raising of parent broiler breeders; production and sale of parent and commercial broiler chicks; research, development, raising, and sale of miniature broiler breeders; the raising and sale of breeding pigs and dairy cows; and sale of dairy products, as well as the production and sale of agricultural and livestock equipment. It also provides environmental control equipment. Shandong Yisheng Livestock & Poultry Breeding Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is based in Yantai, China.
